name: Progress
description:
A task's progress in place: label and percentage, the bar, then a data line with an
optional action. Indeterminate work shows a soft accent bar with the page's shimmer
sweeping through it (still under reduced motion).
signature: ({ value, max, label, meta, action, showValue, tone, size, className, "aria-label": ariaLabel, }: ProgressProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: action
props.description: A trailing control on the meta line, normally a small Cancel button.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: max
props.description: Upper value or visible-item limit, as specified by the type.

props.name: meta
props.description: Data under the bar: "1 of 3 devices completed".

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the percentage at the end of the label line (default when determinate).

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: tone
props.description: The semantic tone. Use danger and warning for consequences and states.

props.name: value
props.description: 0–max, or null while the amount of work is unknown (indeterminate).
